capabilities: Receive messages from nine chat platforms into daily notes
Clip web pages, articles, and community posts into categorized Markdown notes
Download chat attachments and web images into the vault
Bookmark and categorize code-platform links with an extensible registry
Search the vault from a chat channel and send back exported files
extras: Detailed privacy and network-behavior documentation; optional donations via WeChat Pay; plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull messages, shared links, and files from chat platforms like WeChat, Slack, or Telegram into the vault.

requires.name: Chat platform accounts (WeChat, Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp)
Official bot tokens or App ID/Secret for non-QR platforms
Local Chrome, Edge, Brave, or Chromium for private cloud-document rendering

summary: Chat-to-vault capture tool that saves messages, web page clippings, and attachments from nine chat platforms into daily notes.
